known_text: I don't want to give it to him.

use.known: I don't want to give it to him right now.
use.target: 我现在不想给他。

use.known: That young woman asked me if I know your brother.
use.target: 那个年轻的女人问我是不是认识你哥哥。

use.known: If the old man can tell me, I would be very happy.
use.target: 如果那个老人能告诉我的话，我会很开心。

use.known: Everyone told me they want to meet your sister too.
use.target: 大家都告诉我他们也想见你姐姐。

use.known: Would that young man be able to help me with this?
use.target: 那个年轻的男人能帮我做这个吗？

use.known: She hopes I can remember what the old woman said.
use.target: 她希望我能记住那个老女人说了什么。

use.known: I don't want to give it to him because it is mine.
use.target: 我不想给他因为是我的。

use.known: That young man doesn't want to come to the meeting.
use.target: 那个年轻的男人不想来开会。

use.known: If you don't understand, you should ask someone.
use.target: 如果你不了解，你要问人。

use.known: She told me she doesn't know what happened yesterday.
use.target: 她告诉我她不知道昨天发生了什么。

use.known: Everyone here doesn't want to wait any longer.
use.target: 这里的大家都不想再等了。

use.known: Why doesn't your father like to read books with us?
use.target: 你爸爸为什么不喜欢和我们看书？

use.known: I don't want to give it to him until tomorrow.
use.target: 我明天以前不想给他。

use.known: That young woman wanted to know what happened yesterday.
use.target: 那个年轻的女人想知道昨天发生了什么。

use.known: If you want to give her something, do it now.
use.target: 如果你想给她东西的话，现在做。

use.known: Your mother wanted to meet your sister last night.
use.target: 你妈妈昨天晚上想见你姐姐。

use.known: Everyone here wanted to know when the work starts.
use.target: 这里的大家都想知道工作什么时候开始。

use.known: What did that old man want to tell you about?
use.target: 那个老人想告诉你什么？

use.known: I don't want to give it to him because he has one.
use.target: 我不想给他因为他有一个。

use.known: That young woman wants me to give her the answer.
use.target: 那个年轻的女人想我给她答案。

use.known: If you can give me some time, I will help you.
use.target: 如果你能给我一些时间的话，我会帮你。

use.known: She told me to give your father this book.
use.target: 她告诉我给你爸爸这本书。

use.known: Everyone is waiting for him to give us the answer.
use.target: 大家都在等他给我们答案。

use.known: When will your mother give us something to read?
use.target: 你妈妈什么时候会给我们看的书？

use.known: I don't want to give it to him until he asks me.
use.target: 我不想给他，他问我以前。

use.known: That young woman asked if he can come to help tomorrow.
use.target: 那个年轻的女人问他是不是明天能来帮忙。

use.known: If he has time tonight, he will help us with the work.
use.target: 如果他今天晚上有时间的话，他会帮我们做工作。

use.known: I want him to tell us what your father said.
use.target: 我想他告诉我们你爸爸说了什么。

use.known: Everyone is waiting for him to give us the answer.
use.target: 大家都在等他给我们答案。

use.known: Would he be able to remember what happened yesterday?
use.target: 他能记住昨天发生了什么吗？
